To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
quality is the key driver of innovation and competitive advantage.
quality is a reflection of a product's properties that customers use to evaluate the value of a product.
QVM is a quality model which is based on the quality value equation and it is a mathematical tool to measure quality and to predict change.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a quality value model ( QVM ) for the design and construction industries, which can be used to measure the quality of a product, and to provide an effective and efficient means for the management of quality.
the quality of design and the knowledge management process that leads to the development of quality products and services.

the development and implementation of quality management and knowledge systems that can be used to improve the quality of products, processes and services, and enhance organizational performance and productivity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed quality value model (i.e. QVM) is a mathematical technique that enables a company to anticipate changes, and to be more responsive in order to meet the demands
QVM is a tool to assist companies to improve quality management in order to achieve quality and to avoid or minimize losses or weaknesses that result from a poor performance as well.
quality management and knowledge based organizations are the key to success in the competitive global market.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
QVM is a quality management system that uses a mathematical model to predict changes and to manage the uncertainty in decision making.
the proposed QVM model is an innovative approach for quality management and knowledge sharing.
the quality value model is a new approach to the quality revolution.
The main takeaway from our work is that
quality management is the most important factor in the success of any company.
the quality revolution has to be driven by a combination of ICT and creative and innovative capabilities.
quality management and knowledge are essential in the march towards globalization.
